items.text: Oh, hello! I didn’t see you battling by.
Today's update is just some minor maintenance to keep the game running smoothly on all platforms. Hopefully you shouldn’t notice anything out of the ordinary.
Keep on battling on!
Greetings Champions!

We've recently noticed Kleepto has been stealing hard earned keys from players and putting up fake items in the shop. Now that we've caught him, we've forced him to reimburse those broken items. Any key-item-balance issues should now be resolved!
Please keep us posted if you notice any more missing keys, and we'll keep an eye on that pesky Kleepto!
Happy Battling!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193377/86496bfc2945879d8c609e5f7ade223b2b98d30a.png"]
Howdy-do, fellow Champions!
This latest update comes with an engine update and improved graphics. We hope your battles will look better than ever!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193377/86496bfc2945879d8c609e5f7ade223b2b98d30a.png"]
Hello Champions! Today's patch adresses some stability issues in our matchmaking systems. Thanks for playing!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193377/86496bfc2945879d8c609e5f7ade223b2b98d30a.png"]
Hello Champions! Todays patch fixes an issue which blocked recurring events from activating.
We’ve also rescheduled the Big Budget event that was supposed to run last month. It will now be live from August 14 to August 21 so you don’t get left out!
Greetings Champions!
There has been a bug giving players 3 actions. We have updated our algorithms to say 1+1=2 instead of 3, so the problem should now be fixed.
Greetings Champions!
We have upgraded our ranked matchmaking algorithm. Finding a match should now be much quicker.
Hi Champions,

We’re excited to introduce a friends list to the game! It’s now easier than ever to play Demeo Battles with your friends and see if they’re online. You can also easily add people to your friends list that you meet through matchmaking.

releases.displayName: Change to length of Ranked Seasons

items.text: Greetings Champions!
From April 2025 and onwards the length of seasons for ranked mode will be 2 months instead of 1 month.
You now have twice the time to prove your strength and cunning tricks when fighting for glory.

notes.title: Fixed issues with the following Achievements

items.text: Straight Flush
Straight Rush
Leap of Faith
Flawless Victory
Also fixed an issue where certain menu elements would be incorrectly scaled when playing in tilted mode.
Fixed an issue where several achievements failed to unlock after meeting their criteria.
For players who love a challenge - we have now released achievements in "Demeo Battles"!

28 brand new tasks to show off your skills to friends and foes alike. They span from being cooperative to strictly competitive and there are some for every game mode - whether you play singleplayer, ranked matches or casual matches.
What are you waiting for - start unlocking them today!
Achievements
Player blocking
Improved Voice Chat indicators and identification for VR avatars
Line drawing is also muted together with chat muting
UI bug fixes of Ranked presentation results
UI art improvements of social features
Gamepad controller support for Non VR players
Greetings champions!
A few background stability improvements for non-VR players in this update - let the matches resume!
Greetings, Champions!
Getting hands-on with the Assassin was interfering with their stealth - today's patch should help Kai keep to the shadows as intended!
Board pieces that are stealthed or out of line of sight should no longer remain visible if the board piece is being held
Orientation should now be fixed when tilting the game board
See you in the Arena!
Greetings, Champions!
The Reptilian Brute was being a bit too much of a brute, but some retraining has solved that!
Placement matches and leaderboards should now update immediately at the start of each new season
Improved UI handling of 3-digit rank numbers in non-VR
Solved an issue where the camera vignette effect could persist for too long
Reptilian Brute’s leap attack should no longer cause situations where players can no longer interact with objects
Camera handling in VR has been updated to reduce jitter motion when rotating or zooming in/out
See you in the arena!
Greetings, Champions!
Ranked Mode is HERE, packed with new content and features the community has been asking for.
Features

Ranked Mode: Test your skills and ascend through the ranks in month-long seasons, starting from Bronze and aiming for the prestigious Ace tier! When the season concludes, leaderboards will freeze, revealing the ultimate standings for all to behold.

In-Game Events: Get ready for themed monthly events in Demeo Battles! "Rat Week" from April 15-22 offers a 25% discount on rat minions; expect more surprises and future events with unique store adjustments. Join our Discord for updates!

New Arenas, Skins and Card Backs: Explore three exciting new arenas, equip yourself with fresh skins such as the Frostfall skin for the Barbarian and the Troubador skin for the Bard, and discover even more thrilling features!

New Single Player Challenges: Among the 10 new single-player challenges are "Sudden Death," an all-Assassin challenge; "Arachnocalypse," pitting two Hunters against a pair of Guardians alongside a horde of giant spiders; and "Nexus," where players team up as Warlock and Barbarian to face another Warlock/Barbarian duo, navigating through Portals, Detect Enemies, and Ballista obstacles.
Greetings, Champions!
Creatures in the Arena have benefitted from a little extra training, and should now be keen to fight alongside you!
Creatures that drop cards on death now give the cards to the appropriate team
Affects: Elven Spearmen, Sigataur, Elven Hound Master
Note: Creature’s cards are awarded to the player that gets the final blow on the creature - so maybe it’s worth finishing off your low-health Sigataur yourself…?
Solved an issue where creatures may not move on their turn
Note: Creatures higher in the turn queue may still not move if there is no path for them to take (for example, if all movement squares are blocked by creatures later in the turn queue)
We are aware of a VR-specific issue where players’ games can sometimes become blocked by a ‘black wall’ - we are still investigating and working on this issue, and we thank you for your patience!
See you in the arena!
Greetings, Champions!
Our latest update is small but mighty, tackling the Guardian's high survivability in the Burn as well as improved handling of VR headsets being put to sleep during a match.
New creatures and cards are available in Cleepto’s bazaar
The Guardian can no longer survive almost infinitely in the Burn, as her armor is no longer lava-proof
Putting a VR headset to sleep using the power button will no longer stop other players from continuing a game in progress
See you in the arena!

topNew: New creatures and cards are available in Cleepto’s bazaar

items.text: Greetings, Champions!
The new year brings with it a small new update to tackle a couple of little things.
Features
Christmas decorations in the library have been packed away
Bugs - General
Updates to handling of config files
Hidden units are better hidden from cards that target empty tiles
Greetings, champions!

An exciting update has been released, here’s everything you need to know. Now, players will now be able to reach a new max level of 25. We have also added a new page to the catalog, consisting of one NEW MAP, three NEW SKINS and one NEW TOMBSTONE! But it doesn’t stop there, a news section has been added for updates, the library has received some holiday cheer and an Oculus 2D/Rift VR version of the game is now available.
Bug and UI/UX
Post game flow and animations have received some polish
VR Settings Menu UI polish
Team chat now available while shopping
UI updated when placing units - can now see which players have readied up and which are still shopping/placing
Card visuals have been overhauled
Tombstone team colors have been updated for readability
Single player menu has received some polish
Notifications will occur when players unlock a new page of the catalog
The hurricane summoned by Hurricane Anthem is no longer affected by the Burn.
The Leviathan will now be properly targeted and attacked by creatures.
Elven Summoner has updated AI, and will no longer treat heroes on the same team as enemies.
Fixed bug that prevented a unit from showing both how much Bark Armor and Magic Armor it has at the same time.
Fixed bug that prevented Mark of Varga to take armor/magic armor into account when doing damage calculations.
Stellar Strike will no longer hit downed heroes, making aiming with it more reliable.
Fixed bug that would cause certain monster abilities to break the monster turn music.
Other Notes
Locally stored data is no longer shared among all player accounts
Show the equipped item highlight in the inventory (non-VR)
Greetings, Champions!
We have just released a patch update that addresses many areas of the game - including bringing more ability cards into the current rotation!
Opponent's position will no longer be revealed if their hand is full when receiving a card.

Elven Priest's Draining Kiss ability targeting should no longer target Stealthed/Downed targets, or targets outside line of sight.The ability now immediately revives a downed recipient rather than being delayed to the target's turn.
AI Bards should no longer use Courage Shanty on themselves.
AI Warlocks check if the correct target HP is half or lower when using Consuming Vortex.
Skipping turns now works properly in VR.
Fixed bug that caused the game to crash if a tombstone was attacked under certain circumstances.
Fixed rats desyncing in a multiplayer match when spawned in via abilities.
Requirements for unlocking single player stars can now be viewed both before and after a single player game.
Units can no longer end up out of bounds in Cesspool of Despair.
Units using the Buildup ability now cancel their targeting if there is no visible target available, rather than attacking stealthed targets or empty tiles.
All tombstone skins should now display their HP UI properly.
General UI polish.
General improvements to single player AI.
The Unheard One's invincibility buff now ticks at the end of a turn rather than at the start.
Slimes can no longer survive Bottles of Lye if they have defensive buffs such as Courage or Magic Shield.
Revised which cards can appear in chests and be drawn between the rounds.
Made more of the Warlock’s cards available in the shop
See you in the arena!
Hi Champions,

We are aware of the extended period of downtime that affected Quickplay and public matchmaking on Friday night - the issue has now been resolved, and we are monitoring it to do our best to prevent it reocurring.
See you in the Arena!
Hi Champions,
We just released a day one patch that fixed the following things:
General
Improved information shown when queueing for a Quickplay session
Updated UI for various game areas, including adding clearer UI to Hero Select and the Shop when one player is controlling both heroes
AI controlled heroes have had numerous bug fixes that sometimes caused them to break the rules of the game
AI controlled heroes have received improved AI for targeting board pieces as well as certain cards so they use their actions more sensibly
Numerous fixes to the Slime Fusion AI
Fixed bug that made stealth effects on AI players sometimes not function visually
Minor spelling and grammar tweaks
VR-Specific
Solved issue with position of the arena geometry intersecting with the character selection box/shop
Added support for additional languages: German, French, Spanish (Spain), Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional)
Made improvements to hand tracking experience, especially when using menus
Experience and keys are now awarded for all match types - - this includes retroactively awarding them to players who have completed single player missions
See you in the arena!
